Game Overview

At its heart, Color Mosaic is a block game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Color Mosaic comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Color Mosaic?

Color Mosaic is a free block game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Color Mosaic free to play?

Yes, Color Mosaic is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
